# A recorded TLS 1.3 handshake (TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, X25519) from
# "The Illustrated TLS 1.3 Connection" by Michael Driscoll,
# https://github.com/syncsynchalt/illustrated-tls13, captures/capture.pcap
# (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2018 Michael Driscoll). The client's X25519
# private key is 20 21 ... 3f. Line 1: client to server; line 2: server to client.
